title: Dynamic Mechanism and Information Design in AI-Agent Environments: A General Analytical Framework
abstract: arXiv:2610.11177v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a general framework for dynamic mechanism and information design with AI agents, encompassing optimal contracting and integrating evolving hidden information and hidden action with partial verification, technological authorization, and multi-agent interaction. It nests conventional dynamic screening, hidden-action contracting, and conditional dynamic information design, while allowing reporting, action, and information-use decisions to interact through a common continuation mechanism. We establish a dynamic revelation principle and a recursive characterization of implementability in which truthful reporting and post-report obedience are jointly determined through continuation incentives. translated_title: AI智能体环境中的动态机制与信息设计：一个通用分析框架
translated_abstract: 本文为AI智能体环境下的动态机制与信息设计开发了一个通用框架，涵盖最优契约设计，并将不断演化的隐藏信息与隐藏行为同部分可验证、技术授权以及多智能体交互整合在一起。该框架嵌套了传统的动态筛选、隐藏行为契约以及条件动态信息设计，同时允许报告、行动和信息使用决策通过一个共同的后续机制相互作用。我们建立了一个动态显示原理以及对可实施性的递归刻画，其中真实报告与报告后的服从行为通过后续激励被联合确定。在拟线性最优契约环境中，动态包络方法与积分单调性方法给出了经过验证调整的动态虚拟剩余表示，并识别出三个不同的边际：动态信息租金、……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个针对AI智能体的动态机制与信息设计通用分析框架，建立动态显示原理与递归可实施性刻画，并通过动态包络与积分单调性方法导出验证调整后的动态虚拟剩余表示。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a general analytical framework for dynamic mechanism and information design with AI agents, establishing a dynamic revelation principle with a recursive characterization of implementability and deriving a verification-adjusted dynamic virtual-surplus representation via dynamic envelope and integral-monotonicity methods.
